title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Revelation 1: the letter to the seven assemblies, John on Patmos, the one like a son of man, and the seven stars and lamp stands.

questions.text: By whom did God send and make known the Revelation to John?
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:1 says God sent it and made it known by his angel to his servant John.

answers.text: By a voice from the sea

questions.text: To whom does John write this book?
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:4 says John writes to the seven assemblies that are in Asia.

answers.text: The chosen lady and her children
The seven assemblies that are in Asia

questions.text: What does the Lord God call himself in verse 8?
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:8 says, "I am the Alpha and the Omega," says the Lord God, the Almighty.

answers.text: The Lion of the tribe of Judah

questions.text: On which isle was John when he wrote?
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:9 says John was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God's Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

questions.text: Which city is named last in the list of assemblies John is told to write to?
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:11 lists Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and last of all Laodicea.

questions.text: What did John see when he turned to see the voice that spoke with him?
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:12 says that having turned, he saw seven golden lamp stands.

answers.text: A sea of glass like crystal
A book sealed with seven seals

questions.text: What were the eyes of the one like a son of man compared to?
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:14 says his eyes were like a flame of fire.

questions.text: What proceeded out of his mouth?
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:16 says that out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword.

answers.text: A golden sash about his chest

questions.text: Which keys does he say he has?
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:18 says he was dead and is alive forever and ever, and that he has the keys of Death and of Hades.

answers.text: The keys of Death and of Hades
The keys of the seven assemblies

questions.text: What are the seven stars, according to the explanation given to John?
questions.explanation: Revelation 1:20 says the seven stars are the angels of the seven assemblies, and the seven lamp stands are seven assemblies.

answers.text: The angels of the seven assemblies
The seven seals of the book
